track: Track B — Mapping Flood Damage from Space

flood_mapping.method: Multi-temporal Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter change + Sentinel-2 optical spectral filtering

grounded_claims.data_provenance: Copernicus Sentinel-1 C-band SAR (IW VV+VH) + Sentinel-2 MSI
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Modelled candidate surface water extent meeting specular drop / spectral criteria. Zero candidates does NOT prove no flooding occurred; indicates no pixels exceeded detection thresholds.

grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Calculated from resampled bounding box grid transform (approx. 16.8m x 16.2m = 272.4 m² per pixel at 27.9°N latitude, yielding 35.03 ha over 1,286 pixels; nominal 10m grid would be 12.86 ha)
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Represents spatial extent of potential floodwater accumulation; does not measure flood depth or water volume.

grounded_claims.claim_text: Candidate flood extent is grouped into 27 polygon clusters.
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Isolated single-pixel noise filtered during raster morphological cleanup
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Indicates discrete continuous bodies of potential standing water.

grounded_claims.claim_text: 195 buildings are potentially affected by candidate inundation.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Pre-event OpenStreetMap building footprints (2026-07-27T00:00:00Z) intersected with flood candidate polygons
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Modelled 2D spatial overlay only; unconfirmed structural damage or water ingress
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: POTENTIAL EXPOSURE ONLY. Does NOT represent confirmed damaged, collapsed, or destroyed buildings. Field structural inspection required.

grounded_claims.data_provenance: Pre-event OpenStreetMap highway ways (2026-07-27T00:00:00Z) intersected with flood candidate polygons
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Spatial intersection of road centerline geometries with 2D inundation candidate extent
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: POTENTIAL EXPOSURE ONLY. Indicates road sections passing through potential water; physical passability requires road patrol verification.

grounded_claims.claim_text: 59.26 km of road network is potentially affected.
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Sum of lengths of intersected road line segments
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Cumulative exposed highway length, not length of destroyed pavement.

grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: 2D overlay does not model bridge deck vertical clearance above river stage
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: POTENTIAL EXPOSURE ONLY. High clearance bridges may remain open despite water below deck; structural engineering inspection required.

grounded_claims.claim_text: 3,748 road segments were disrupted in the modeled graph.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Network graph topology generated from vehicle-accessible OSM highways
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Subdivided network graph edges removed due to candidate water intersection
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Modelled edges severed in routing graph; emergency 4x4 or clearance operations may restore access.

grounded_claims.claim_text: Pre-event baseline road network had 181 connected components.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Connected components analysis of pre-event OSM road graph
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Graph topological analysis based on connected road subgraphs
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Represents baseline network fragmentation prior to flood disruption.

grounded_claims.claim_text: Post-disruption road network fractured into 252 connected components.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Connected components analysis of post-disruption OSM road graph
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Difference indicates network fragmentation into isolated road pockets
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Increase in components indicates network fragmentation into disconnected clusters.

grounded_claims.claim_text: 589 settlements were evaluated for route connectivity.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Pre-event OpenStreetMap place nodes (towns, villages, hamlets)
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Settlements snapped to nearest road graph node within 2,500m tolerance
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: Total settlements within AOI successfully mapped to the vehicle road graph.

grounded_claims.claim_text: 18 settlements were modeled as potentially cut off from town/city hubs.
grounded_claims.data_provenance: Topological Dijkstra pathfinding from settlement nodes to town/city hubs
grounded_claims.confidence_or_uncertainty: Modelled vehicular road disconnection only; unconfirmed real-world physical isolation
grounded_claims.interpretation_guidance: MODELED TOPOLOGICAL DISRUPTION ONLY. Settlement nodes that lost all motorable road paths to municipal town/city hubs in the network graph. Does NOT confirm real-world physical isolation; pedestrian tracks, air access, or river crossings may be viable.
When False, hospital connectivity cannot be evaluated and municipal town/city hubs were utilized as fallback critical destinations.

limitations: The flood output is a modelled potential inundation candidate, not confirmed physical damage.
Potentially affected assets are based on candidate spatial overlap; not confirmed structural destruction.
Potentially cut-off settlements represent modelled topological network disconnections, not confirmed real-world isolation.
Validation layers (EMSR927 / UNOSAT) are strictly checking-only and excluded from analytical pipelines.
This system is an educational and research prototype for the Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026.
Historical hospital data was unavailable in the pre-event snapshot; municipal town/city hubs were utilized for modeled road connectivity.

data_provenance.sentinel_sar: Copernicus Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR, IW mode, VV+VH)
data_provenance.sentinel_optical: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI (Level-2A BOA, SCL masked)
